verdict.rationale: Sprint planning is a fair question for a work-management platform like monday.com, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions sprints, backlogs, story points, burndown or any agile/scrum feature. The only nearby evidence is generic boards, automated status reports and GitHub/GitLab PR linking, which are adjacent features rather than sprint planning and earn no credit.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can plan and manage sprints for agile software development
